scope: Separate upstream selection after rejection of eight fragmented historical masks
selection_before_fitting: Decompose each complete frozen mask by original indexed shared edges; select exactly the component with greatest acquired triangle area; ties use minimum original face ID
retention: Store all parent face memberships, component labels and component area/face-count ledger; unselected components are retained observations, not deleted physical geometry
geometry_change: None; source indices and coordinates remain original
fitting: Reuse the unchanged pinned plane/quadratic fitter, fixed original-ID split, full-mask area weighting policy and complete-triangle Bernstein screen
short_support: Retain without fitting when the unchanged fitter's 40 training / 10 holdout source-vertex minima fail
native_acceptance: No automatic native acceptance; projection/trim topology and native export remain independent requirements even if a graph bound passes
